name: Average ERP (MNE)
summary: Averages MNE epochs of selected conditions into an evoked response (ERP) with MNE-Python and outputs the evoked file, a joint ERP plot and an HTML report.
description: Reads an MNE epochs file, selects the epochs of the listed stimulus names, averages them into an Evoked object named by condition, and plots a joint ERP figure with topomaps at the given peaks. Use it to compute ERPs after epoching. Note: average_all is compared with the string 'True' and that branch does not set the evoked variable, so averaging all epochs may fail; list the stimulus names instead.

inputs.description: MNE epochs file (-epo.fif) with event names for the conditions.

outputs.description: One instance of Evoked based on the condition specified

parameters.description:
Do you want all of your epoch types/stimuli/conditions to be averaged together?
If not, enter the names of the epoch types/stimuli/conditions in the string below.
Enter here a list of your stimulus/condition names to be merged into one, if you want them to be merged and averaged together.
What to name your ERP as a condition of averaging (e.g. "all", "Visual", "N170", "Parietal", etc). Just enter the name with no quotation marks.
Add a list (comma-separated) of time values at which you would like to display topomaps on a joint ERP plot.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21, 809-813 (2024).
